one_minute_value_explanation: v12.0 lets operators review provider-backed decisions from one read-only Mission Control console that shows proposed action, evidence, approval boundary, rollback boundary, and no-autonomous-write limits.
thirty_second_version_delta: v11.9 showed how AI tool calls were governed; v12.0 combines provider decision, freshness, safety, and tool governance into one operator Go/No-Go console.
product_review_trigger: If an operator still cannot tell whether to accept, defer, reopen, or block a provider-backed path from Mission Control, reopen this as a product issue.
not_proven: Capability delta does not prove provider truth, semantic truth, production execution safety, market value, or broad adoption.
